title: Heroes that move like heroes
text:
The seven hero models get arms, real attacks and a lot more life.

✨ Hero models now have working shoulders and elbows. Weapons, shields and staves stay in their hands, the Celestus and the Bard grip their swords two-handed, and the Celestus' wings have their own joints
✨ Every class attacks its own way, in three alternating blows: the Bulwark thrusts, bashes with the shield and strikes overhead; the Barbarian smashes, sweeps and uppercuts; the Shade stabs right, left and with both blades; the Arcanist thrusts the staff and throws a hand; the Hunter aims, draws and looses; the Celestus and the Bard chop, cut upward and thrust two-handed
⬆️ A real running stride: each foot plants and sweeps back at ground speed so feet no longer slide, the back heel kicks up, there's a moment of flight between steps, and the stride is long and unhurried instead of a fast shuffle
⬆️ The whole body runs with the legs: hips turn toward the leading leg and drop on the swinging side, the chest counter-turns, arms pump against the legs with the elbows bent, the head stays steady, and heroes lean into speed and bank into turns. Weapons, shields and staves stay in the hands throughout
⬆️ When you are in combat your hero drops into a stance: knees bent, guard or weapon raised. Stealthed Shades crouch low
⬆️ Each class has its own casting pose (the Arcanist lifts the staff high, the Celestus raises her sword and spreads her wings) and a flick when the spell lets go
⬆️ Standing heroes breathe, shift their weight from foot to foot and look around. Jumps tuck the legs and throw the arms out, and landings bend the knees
⬆️ Heroes flinch when struck, stroke with their arms when swimming, hold the reins when riding, and fall one of three ways when they die. Wave, cheer, dance and bow now use the arms too
